req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must return HTTP 400 when the squad_number in the path does not match the squad_number in the request body. The route handler checks `if player_model.squad_number != squad_number` and raises HTTPException(400). Tests must cover: (1) positive — matching IDs accepted (no 400), (2) negative — mismatched IDs rejected with exactly 400, (3) boundary — squad_number differs by exactly ±1 (off-by-one mutation resilience), (4) decision-table — both sides of the equality check, (5) NEG — body squad_number is zero or negative. Mutation targets: the `!=` operator (could be mutated to `==`, `<`, `>`), the status code constant 400 (could become 422 or 404), and the field being compared (squad_number).

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Kabir Mary Reddy)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body squad_number=10 (path matches body)
expected: Response status code is NOT 400 (mismatch guard does not trigger)
Response status code is 204 or 500 (route proceeds past the mismatch check)
trace: R-PLAYER-011: when path==body the 400 branch must NOT fire
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code in (204, 500)

test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected()
